summary: Server game-state component that drives unloading a session through esv::SessionUnloadSystem::Update (game per-frame update bg3.exe+0x2B21420, Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xC45EC0): a step counter 0..5 (UnloadPart1/2/3 ... then ExecuteSessionUnloadedEvent) plus a wait flag and a frame counter. Many server systems read its presence as a condition. Never seen alive. Registry total 24 (server row).

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2A97240 (AllocRaw 0x18) zeroes the qword at +0; neither the game update nor the Toolkit Update reads it.

fields.name: Waiting
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes +8. Update bg3.exe+0x2B21420: `w = *(int*)(p + 8); if (w == 0) break...; if (w == 1 && ++counter > 4) *(uint64*)(p + 8) = 0`; every step sets it to 1 after doing its work. Toolkit: `if (*(int*)(p + 8) == 0) switch (*(int*)(p + 0x10))` - the step runs only when it is 0. Name inferred.

fields.name: WaitFrames
fields.evidence: Update increments `*(int*)(p + 0xC)` while waiting and clears it (with +8) once it exceeds 4. Name inferred.

fields.name: Stage
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes +0x10. Update: `switch(*(uint32*)(p + 0x10))`, values 0..5, each case writes the next stage (1, 2, 3, 4, ...); Toolkit cases call UnloadPart1/2/3 and GameEventManager::ExecuteSessionUnloadedEvent.
